verdict.rationale: Docs extensively cover handoffs (delegating tasks between agents), agents-as-tools (subagent-style invocation without full handoff), the Runner class for orchestrating runs, and tracing that records handoffs/tool calls across a multi-agent run — directly matching handoffs/subagents/crew-style orchestration in one workflow. Community commentary corroborates real-world use for simple-to-moderate multi-agent workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of complex crew-style (many-agent, hierarchical) orchestration at scale beyond simple use cases.
